messages:
maria: Hey team, noticed a big spike in 502s from hosted API starting ~08:12 UTC. Customer traffic shows large number of short requests failing. Dashboard: error-rate jump +20% and a bunch of backend 5xxs.
kevin: I rolled a quota tweak to the per-key burst window 2h ago to reduce tail latency. Did we accidentally change something else? :thinking_face:
infra-bot: deploybot: config-service:quota-service v2.14.1 promoted to prod by kevin at 08:05 UTC. CI: all checks passed.
sophie: Can you pull the effective config from the console? Maybe unit mismatch.
maria: Console shows: ```
quota_config:
  scope: per_key
  limit: 1200
  window: 60ms
  burst_capacity: 500
```
maria: Wait, that window is 60ms — we intended 60s. :facepalm: That explains why tokens were refilled too fast -> huge synced bursts hitting backend
kevin: Ugh, my bad. I updated the playground YAML quickly and PR had `60ms` because I was testing a micro-batching patch. I thought the tests would catch it.
kevin: I can roll a hotfix to set window: 60s immediately.
dave: Heads up — quota-service is feature-flag guarded; changing config will be rolled via rollout service. We can patch the runtime override in the admin console for emergency.
sophie: Rollout plan: 1) set runtime override for prod quota-service to 60s 2) watch burst metrics for 5 minutes 3) rollback if errors. Who can do console override?
oncall: I'm available. I can apply the override and monitor. Applying now.
oncall: Applied runtime override: `per_key.window=60s` at 08:27 UTC. Pushed to all regions.
infra-bot: metric-alert: backend_pods_cpu spiked to 92% during the 08:14-08:25 window. autoscaler: added 3 pods, thrash observed.
maria: After override, 502s down to baseline within ~90s. Looks good. Dashboard: error-rate back to normal.
kevin: Sorry everyone. I'll open a postmortem and add a lint rule to reject `ms` units in prod quota configs by accident.
dave: Also create a console validation: if window < 1s warn. Add to backlog and tag security/ops.
sophie: Add mitigation doc for emergency runtime overrides to the oncall runbook.
maria: Thanks oncall and infra. Posting customer notice draft in #customer-success for transparency.
kevin: Will also revert the feature-flag default in the PR to avoid future accidental test flips. :thumbsup:
maria: Closing incident once postmortem + runbook updates are in. Good catch, team.
